16,000 miles. Mostly fast charging. Still 99% battery health.

A Tesla Model Y owner completed a full battery test after six months and found virtually no capacity loss, despite using DC fast charging more than home charging.

The takeaway? Fast charging isn't the enemy. Keeping the battery away from extreme charge levels and preconditioning before charging may matter far more than many people think.
